faqLeft.q: What engine does the Land Rover Discovery Sport P290 use?
faqLeft.a: The Discovery Sport P290 uses the Ingenium AJ200P — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol engine. It was produced only from 2019 to 2020 and represents the highest petrol output in the Discovery Sport range.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover Discovery Sport P290 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,000. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Discovery Sport P290?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the Ingenium AJ200P before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild Ingenium AJ200P Discovery Sport P290 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chains, bearings and gaskets as standard on every AJ200P rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Discovery Sport P290 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Discovery Sport P290 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Discovery Sport P290 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Discovery Sport P290 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
